title: How the sheet is arranged
question: The timetable is locked. Which arrangement of Reed’s home should Loomed and Weft follow too?

options.label: Side words
options.thesis: A word column on the left, the departures on the right, red only when the knot is late.
options.viewport: Reed, Home, Discover, Compose, Search, Settings, Identity down the left. Time, Author, Post across the sheet. Cannot reach knot in red above the rows.
options.risk: The left column can feel like every other app’s sidebar if the rules go soft.

options.label: Top rule
options.thesis: The words sit on one line. The sheet uses the whole width.
options.viewport: Reed and the six destinations across the top, Home underlined in red. Six rows of Time, Author, Post. Cannot reach knot at the top right.
options.risk: On a phone the top line has nowhere to go unless it stacks.

options.label: Large time
options.thesis: The clock is the headline. The post sits beside it, smaller.
options.viewport: The same left words. Three rows. 09:14 is huge. Ada and the post are the destination, set small.
options.risk: A long post, or a thread, has to shrink back down or the time stops being the point.
